name: h3_native_pilot
description: Nine text-only pilot tasks for native multimodal graph discovery. Reference frames/clips may be extracted from actual drafts. This pilot is not a complete multimodal reference benchmark.

tasks.prompt: Three consecutive shots of one woman with short black hair, a red coat and a silver crescent brooch: a wide view as she enters a station, a close view as she checks her pocket watch, and a side view as she boards a train. Keep her face, brooch, coat and watch unchanged. Show every action in order.

identity_across_shots.description: The same face and distinctive brooch in all shots

shot_and_action_coverage.description: All three requested shots and actions in order

object_persistence.description: Watch and coat details remain stable

tasks.prompt: Three consecutive shots of the same elderly potter with a white beard, green apron and round glasses: he carries a blue vase into a sunlit workshop, inspects the vase in close-up, then puts it on a wooden shelf. Preserve the man, his glasses and the vase pattern across cuts.

identity_across_shots.description: Face, beard, apron and glasses remain consistent

shot_and_action_coverage.description: Three ordered shots and complete requested actions

object_persistence.description: The same vase pattern in all shots

tasks.prompt: Three shots of the same violinist with curly brown hair, a dark blue jacket and a red wristband: she opens a violin case backstage, tunes her violin in close-up, then walks onto the stage holding it. Preserve her identity, wristband and violin across every transition.

identity_across_shots.description: Same face, hairstyle, jacket and wristband

shot_and_action_coverage.description: All three requested stages visibly occur in order

tasks.prompt: In one continuous shot, a chef picks up a whole tomato, cuts it into slices, transfers all slices into an empty pan, then stirs them. The cutting must finish before transfer begins. No tomato pieces should disappear, duplicate or appear in the pan early.

temporal_order.description: Pick up, cut, transfer, stir in order

state_transition.description: Whole tomato becomes slices and then enters pan

tasks.prompt: A person folds a blank paper into a paper airplane, places it on the table, picks it up again and throws it forward. Show the stages sequentially in a continuous view. The airplane must not exist before folding, and the same airplane must be thrown.

temporal_order.description: Fold, place, pick up, throw in that order

state_transition.description: Flat sheet visibly becomes an airplane

physical_consistency.description: No duplicated or spontaneously appearing airplane

tasks.prompt: A mechanic removes a flat bicycle wheel, places it beside the bicycle, picks up a replacement wheel and installs it. Show each stage in that order. The original wheel remains on the floor after removal and the replacement wheel is distinct until installed.

temporal_order.description: Remove, place, pick up replacement, install

state_transition.description: Bicycle has no front wheel between removal and replacement

physical_consistency.description: Both wheels maintain their identities and positions

tasks.prompt: A red toy car drives behind an opaque box and emerges on the other side still red and with the same white stripe. The camera then moves to a closer side view while the car stops beside a blue cube. The box and cube stay fixed throughout.

occlusion_identity.description: Same red car and stripe after occlusion

spatial_consistency.description: Box and cube do not move or change

action_coverage.description: Car passes behind box and stops beside cube with camera change

tasks.prompt: A woman wearing a yellow scarf carries a striped umbrella behind a stone pillar. She emerges with the same scarf and umbrella, closes the umbrella and leans it against the pillar. Keep the pillar and street layout fixed as the camera gently moves closer.

occlusion_identity.description: Woman, scarf and umbrella match before and after occlusion

spatial_consistency.description: Pillar and street geometry remain stable

action_coverage.description: Pass pillar, close umbrella, lean it against pillar

tasks.prompt: A dancer with a white jacket and a black hat walks behind a red curtain and reappears wearing the same clothes. He removes the hat, spins once and places the hat on a chair. Keep his identity, the chair and the stage geometry consistent across the occlusion and movement.

occlusion_identity.description: Same dancer and clothing after curtain occlusion

action_coverage.description: Reappear, remove hat, spin once, place hat on chair
